To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the sericite/CTAB complex is stable under the conditions of ultrasonic cleaning, different temperatures, and different solution pHs, (2) the intercalated layer of sericite is stable under different washing solvents except ethanol and methanol, and (3) sericite/pure epoxy resin and sericite/epoxy/epoxy resin nanocomposites were prepared with the stable interlayer of sericite, which exhibited good properties.

(i) the sericite can be intercalated by cetyl trimethylammonium ions (CTAB) and the interlayer space can be expanded to more than 2.0 nm, and the intercalated structure is stable under different conditions; (ii) sericite can serve as a good filler to produce nanocomposites with epoxy resin; and (iii) the sericites with different interlayer spaces have different effects on the mechanical properties of epoxy nanocomposites

(1) sericite interlayer spacing can be expanded by CTAB intercalation; (2) the stability of the CTAB intercalated sercite can be enhanced by changing washing solvent and ultrasonic cleaning; and (3) the sericite/p (Epoxy resin) composites can be prepared by the stable sericite and have excellent properties.

the stability of the CTAB-modified sericite, which is the first step for the preparation of polymer/sercite nanocomposites, and the preparation of the sercite/polymer nanomaterials with good properties.
the stability of the CTAB-intercalated sericites and the application of the stable sericite as the filler for polymer nanocomposite.
the stability of the CTAB-intercalated sericites and the preparation of sericite/pure epoxy resin nanocomposites.
